title: DevBench — Dashboard
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: Platform badge
items.text: Which Amiga this devbench drives, from the active profile's build arch; the stripe along the top uses the same colour (orange = PPC, blue = 68k).

items.label: Free memory
items.text: Free chip and fast RAM from the last bridge heartbeat (HB line).

items.label: Emulator status
items.text: Whether the devbench-managed emulator process is running.

items.label: Arch · profile
items.text: Target CPU architecture and active devbench.toml profile.

items.label: Bridge tri-state
items.text: Red = serial disconnected, yellow = serial linked but no bridge traffic, green = bridge heartbeats flowing (pulses on each heartbeat), amber = bridge silent.

items.label: Tab bar
items.text: Dashboard, Logs, Files, Tools, Inspect, Develop, Debugger, Settings (plus FS-UAE when a patched FS-UAE's debug RPC is reachable).

items.label: Connection
items.text: Serial/TCP link to the bridge daemon: host, port, log-buffer size and number of tracked variables.

items.label: System status
items.text: Latest heartbeat tick and free chip / fast memory reported by the daemon.

items.label: Clients
items.text: Programs registered with the bridge via ab_init() (MCP: amiga_list_clients).

items.label: Bridge capabilities
items.text: Daemon version, protocol level, max line length and every supported command, from CAPABILITIES (MCP: amiga_capabilities).

items.label: Emulator control
items.text: Status, PID and uptime of the emulator, with Start / Restart / Stop (MCP: amiga_emulator_*).

items.label: Send command
items.text: Raw bridge protocol console with one-click PING, LISTTASKS, LISTLIBS, MEMMAP… and the reply shown underneath.
